profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
9+ years - Software Engineer supporting services and front-end features of top-tier social games 
22+ years - Full stack web development

Core:  JavaScript, JS Web Frameworks, OOP, TDD, HTML, CSS, APIs, REST, JSON, UI/UX, SQL

Active:  Vue, Vite, Rollup, webpack, npm, Node.js, PM2, Express.js, Sass, Maven, Spring Boot, Java, Git, Gitlab, Bitbucket, GitHub, Docker, Linux, macOS, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Opsgenie, Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Kibana/OpenSearch Dashboards, Akamai, Tealium, Snyk

Prior:  Angular, Lodash, PrimeNG, Bootstrap, RxJS, MySQL, MongoDB, Couchbase, PHP, Apache, jQuery, Mercurial, Subversion, Perforce, Facebook APIs/SDKs, Analytics Implementation, Jenkins, GoCD, various CMS, AWS, Windows, Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator, XML, XPath, XSLT, E-commerce

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Search Experience team Tech Lead and Front-End Dev

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Search Platform and Search Experience teams Front-End Dev

• Guide and develop responsive, scalable and accessible web apps, component
packages, tools, and analytics for REI.com’s evolving search experience
• Support feature growth and large-scale migrations for employee tools and the public
REI.com search experience footprint of navigation browsing, keyword search results, and more.
• Build scalable front-end systems using JavaScript (ES6), TypeScript, npm, Vue, SCSS,
Vite, webpack, Git, etc. across large-scale, interconnected systems. Support incidents.
• Translate complex UX/UI designs into high-performing, refined user interfaces.
• Partner cross-functionally with UX designers, backend engineers, analysts, vendors, and
product and program stakeholders in an Agile (Scrum & Kanban) contexts to deliver key, valuable features.
• Build web accessible (WCAG standards), cross-browser compatible, performant, and
monitorable features in team and external team repos using org tech & design systems.
• Elevate clean code practices and iterative design through discussion, mentoring and
peer reviews in Git collaboration platforms.
• Build unit and integration testing driven by GitLab and other CI pipeline workflows.
• Modernize legacy search platform tool systems and grow org documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and original engineer of internal tool portal for the latest DoubleDown casino mobile game apps

Increase, diversify and upgrade features in DoubleDown Fort Knox game app through tooling solutions for advanced UI behavior and complex config dependencies
- Service lower-level game design config needs in test and production environments, as well as multiple full-featured metagame configuration requests 
- Transition Angular framework versions and solve dependency issues
- Build new tool features, improve capabilities, eliminate workarounds, and reduce code complexity

Mentor colleagues and assist with troubleshooting and QA processes
- Lead best practices and help solve problems to maintain team member velocity on deliverables
- Support internal strategies for test planning and quality and functional evaluation of feature work
- Gather QA or bug info at the border between internal and external concerns
- Expand deployment and pre-deployment techniques to increase team output through flexibility and improve testing pipeline workflow outcomes.

Monitor multiple streams of related platform and product development discussions, address concerns in feature planning, and inform discussion of outcomes during testing pipeline progress
- Build momentum in feature work and provide context to rework trouble areas through cross-team understanding
- Create better tooling using identified advantages and limitations of a project or external service

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributor to the tooling and transition of DoubleDown Casino's massively popular flagship game apps from a monolithic legacy service framework to feature services and a micro-service architecture for stability, feature flexibility and cost advantages

Design and lead development of TBX toolbox service and portal to provide tooling for the latest DoubleDown games including DoubleDown Classic and DoubleDown Fort Knox mobile apps
- Deliver varied internal teams standardized role-based tools to manage player data, provide user rewards, generate marketing links and promotions, remotely configure game clients, and schedule game features and behavior for segmented user populations

Tackle incomplete or unfamiliar tooling during org transitions
- Complete, improve and expand unfamiliar AngularJS tooling related to unreleased in-game loyalty feature and related micro-service
- Maintain, edit and deploy legacy Java-based game and slot management tooling

Extract service feature components from legacy monolithic DoubleDown Casino service architecture to improve performance, reduce fragility, and improve player experiences
- Implement and help transition in-game virtual currency concerns to new balance services that improve player game experiences and reduce both instability and hardware costs

Execute general Facebook API updates involving purchasing and retention
- Maintain revenue flow and user activity during Facebook system changes and increase robustness of in-game social network revenue streams

Troubleshoot collaboration conflicts, build team best practices, drive unit testing, and create on-boarding documentation
- Unblock time-sensitive feature releases, reduce bug regressions, and reduce new team member transition from one week to a single day

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer of Facebook Canvas and iOS mobile games services and features to enrich, engage, grow and maintain massive audiences

Overview
•	Build, extend and maintain internal frameworks of scalable web services (PHP, MySQL, Couchbase) and JavaScript services and interfaces for connected, persistent, “play anywhere” games
•	Launch and support Bejeweled Blitz, the first PopCap Facebook Canvas effort and a multi-year top 10 and top 25 contender in MAUs
•	Support evolving features for browser-based Flash and native mobile iOS game clients for Solitaire Blitz with over 1M monthly users

•	Plan, estimate and discuss features and projects to maintain focus on near-term growth in balance with efficient team direction towards long-term sustainability
•	Collaborate with product owners and team (artists, UX and game designers, analysts, CS) in timely, iterative style from original goals/comps through emergent play tweaks or customer emergencies
•	Utilize agile practices with cross-disciplinary team including pair programming, test-driven development and refactoring with fellow engineers as part of a continuous integration approach

Specifics
•	Design data structures and application architecture to support scalable approaches to new features
•	Implement marketing and virality features as well as optimizations and experiments to grow revenue and player base, including:

o	A/B test mechanisms and analytics (E-commerce, game economy, player data, etc.)
o	Facebook APIs including Payment and Open Graph development
o	In-game gift redemption features with Customer Service and Marketing admin tools
o	3rd-party advertising and promotions integrations (OpenX, TrialPay)

•	Develop dynamic JS/HTML/CSS E-commerce cart, viral, and promotional features that meshed with Facebook Canvas APIs, optimal game experiences, and Magento product catalog
•	Create and update game-based CRM and test tools for Customer Service, QA and Marketing efforts

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Primary brand and web developer for start-up soft drink company

- Perform competitive/market research related to branding and web presence
- Initiate branding and prototype site design based on client requirements
- Integrate web standards compliance and CSS style/content separation
- Assist with investor presentation materials and photography

Primary technology consultant for a web-based venture capital company specializing in fund-raising documents and screening tools that create custom reports on VC firms and private equity parties

- Configure and administer remote web server, user accounts, software, scripts and mailing lists
- Architect and implement dynamic digital document (PDF and Excel) creation and distribution system
- Design and administer MySQL DB for website, proprietary report content and product/order tracking
- Document hardware/software implementations and discuss with clients and potential investors
- Integrate static and dynamic document distribution with preexisting E-commerce system
- Design and optimize site user experience, web forms and functionality based on client requirements
- Research and implement marketing requirements, which include search engine optimization and custom DB driven applications that analyze ad costs and conversion rates
- Support phone/email customer service requests and perform on-site IT, network and office admin

Consultant and site designer/developer for a provider of expert legal, business, financial, and investor documents and presentations - prototyped only, the site is not online

- Configure and administer remote web server, user accounts, software packages and SSL cert creation
- Configure ready-made E-commerce system and integrate custom document management system
- Design, implement and optimize site look-and-feel and functionality based on client requirements

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Technology consultant and webmaster for sandiegocalsoap.com, a state and federal pre-college assistance program for disadvantaged and low-income K-14 students, and instructor for a related middle-school summer technology program, GEAR UP Verizon Summer Residential Program 2001

- Administer remote web server
- Redesign previous Flash-based site into static HTML and provide ongoing updates
- Adapt and refresh existing brand, organize existing content, research and include new data
- Create PHP-based online photo album for documentation of program events
- Develop curriculum, educational materials and instruct in one-on-one and classroom environments

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
Front-end developer and designer in the User Experience Group for the Chicago branch of the internet consulting and solutions group later known as Niteo Partners; produced work for Sara Lee Corporation, Burger King, Motorola and 3Com.

- Manage site-wide front-end production, following established timelines
- Contribute to multi-disciplined team discussions and consult during client project meetings
- Develop HTML, animations (Flash), illustrations and sound design for live sites, intranets, marketing presentations and in-house projects
- Produce HTML templates from Photoshop comps and PDFs from web and print sources (QuarkXpress); optimize graphics for the web and manage site updates and content rotation

projects.title: Solitaire Blitz: Lost Treasures [Facebook/canvas game]
projects.description: Meet a cast of whimsical undersea characters! Explore Caribbean islands filled with adventurous quests wrapped around a fast-paced treasure hunt Solitaire themed social game! Match cards quickly to clear the decks in 60 seconds, collect treasures, and compete with friends.
